high_level_description: The image is a combination of a photograph and a quote. On the left side, there is a block of text with a motivational message attributed to Teal Swan. The text reads: "Many of us have the self-defeating belief that everything that is worth having is hard won. But this belief ensures that we are going about life in the wrong way. We should approach things with much more ease. Doing things the hard way causes stress, and stress in actuality, keeps the desired results from you."
